description: Fetch a proteome by UPID (e.g. "UP000005640"), which can name a reference, non-reference, or excluded proteome, or the reference proteome for an organism by NCBI taxon ID (e.g. 9606) — provide exactly one. Returns metadata inline: proteome type (with UniProt's reasons when excluded), total protein count, gene count, reviewed, unreviewed, and additional isoform protein counts, Complete Proteome Detector (CPD) status, BUSCO completeness (score, complete/fragmented/missing counts, lineage dataset), and the genome assembly accession. UniProt computes the gene count and the reviewed, unreviewed, and isoform counts for reference proteomes only, so they are omitted elsewhere. The protein set is opt-in via include_proteins (it is large) and returns a capped page with a forward cursor; narrow it with the query filter (UniProtKB Lucene syntax) for a subset. Resolve an organism name to a taxon ID first with uniprot_get_taxonomy.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from this tool for the same resolved UPID and exact query. Identifier aliases resolving to that UPID and size changes are allowed. Older raw cursors are rejected; restart without cursor. Only meaningful with include_proteins.

include_proteins.description: When true, also return a capped, cursor-paginated page of the proteome's proteins. Defaults to false — metadata alone is the common case.

query.description: Optional UniProtKB Lucene filter to narrow the protein list, e.g. "reviewed:true AND keyword:KW-0067". Only applies when include_proteins is true.

size.description: Proteins per page when include_proteins is true. Default 25; a value above 500, UniProt's page maximum, returns 500 and says so.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxon ID, e.g. 9606 for human. Prefers an exact reference proteome; otherwise resolves a unique descendant reference, or returns candidate UPIDs and taxon IDs for explicit selection. Provide this OR upid, not both.

upid.description: Proteome UPID. Provide this OR taxon_id, not both.

name: uniprot_get_proteome

cap.description: The page-size cap that was applied.

cursor.description: Forward cursor for the next protein page. Absent on the last page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `ambiguous_proteome`: Multiple descendant reference proteomes exist or candidate pages remain. `missing_identifier`: Neither upid nor taxon_id was provided. `conflicting_identifier`: Both upid and taxon_id were provided. `not_found`: No proteome has the UPID, or the taxon has no reference proteome. `invalid_query`: The query filter has unbalanced parentheses (rejected before any request), or UniProtKB rejected it — the message names the rejected field or syntax. `invalid_cursor`: The protein cursor is malformed, from an older version, belongs to another tool, resolved UPID or query, or UniProt could not continue from it (HTTP 500). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance: the requested and applied size when size was above the 500-row page maximum; how to reach the rest when the protein page was capped (walk the cursor or narrow with the query filter); or that no protein matched.

proteins.description: A capped page of the proteome's proteins. Present only when include_proteins is true.

functionSnippet.description: Opening of the first FUNCTION annotation, evidence references stripped: whole sentences within 250 characters (at least the first; one over 400 is cut at a word and ends with …). The complete annotation with evidence is uniprot_get_entry function. Omitted when none.

functionSnippetMolecule.description: The isoform, chain, or peptide the functionSnippet annotation is about, as UniProt names it, e.g. "Glucagon" or "Isoform 2". Omitted when UniProt names none, so the snippet is about the protein the row describes, and whenever functionSnippet is.

geneNames.description: Every name of each gene in UniProt order: gene name, synonyms, ordered-locus names (e.g. "b3296", "JW3258"), and ORF names (e.g. "J0580").

items.description: A gene name, synonym, ordered-locus name, or ORF name.

commonName.description: Organism common name. Omitted when none.

proteinName.description: Recommended protein name. Omitted when none.

reviewed.description: True for reviewed Swiss-Prot, false for unreviewed TrEMBL.

sequenceFlags.description: UniProt's sequence flags: "Fragment" or "Fragments" (several non-adjacent pieces) when the sequence is incomplete, so length counts only the residues UniProt holds, not the whole protein; "Precursor" when the sequence is processed into a shorter mature form (signal, propeptide, transit peptide, or initiator methionine cleaved). Omitted when UniProt flags none.

items.description: One flag, as UniProt words it.

busco.description: BUSCO completeness report. Absent for proteomes without one.

lineageDb.description: BUSCO lineage dataset, e.g. "primates_odb10". Omitted when none.

cpdStatus.description: Complete Proteome Detector (CPD) status — where proteinCount falls among at least 30 closely related proteomes, as UniProt words it: "Standard", "Close to standard (high value)", "Close to standard (low value)", "Outlier (high value)", "Outlier (low value)", or "Unknown" (too few related proteomes to score). Omitted when UniProt sends none.

exclusionReasons.description: Why UniProt excluded the proteome, e.g. ["genome length too small"] or ["contaminated"]. Present on excluded proteomes only.

items.description: One reason, as UniProt words it.

geneCount.description: Number of genes the proteins come from — at most proteinCount, below it where genes have several protein entries. Omitted where UniProt has not computed it (it reports 0 on non-reference and excluded proteomes).

genomeAssembly.description: Genome assembly accession, e.g. "GCA_000001405.29". Omitted when none.

isoformProteinCount.description: Additional isoform sequences, counted outside proteinCount. Omitted together with reviewedProteinCount.

commonName.description: Organism common name. Omitted when none.

mnemonic.description: Organism mnemonic, e.g. "HUMAN". Omitted when none.

proteinCount.description: Total number of proteins in the proteome.

proteomeType.description: Proteome type as UniProt words it, e.g. "Reference proteome", "Non Reference proteome", or "Excluded".

reviewedProteinCount.description: Reviewed (Swiss-Prot) proteins; with unreviewedProteinCount it sums to proteinCount. Omitted, with the unreviewed and isoform counts, where UniProt has not computed them (it reports 0 for all three on non-reference and excluded proteomes).

unreviewedProteinCount.description: Unreviewed (TrEMBL) proteins; 0 when every protein is reviewed. Omitted together with reviewedProteinCount.

query.description: The protein filter as supplied by the caller.

shown.description: Number of proteins returned in this page.

totalProteinsMatched.description: Total proteins matching the (optionally filtered) proteome query.

truncated.description: True when the protein page hit the size cap — more remain via cursor.

title: uniprot-mcp-server: get proteome
